Conversation queue.copy: Keeps conversation selection, unread state, and agent ownership visible without creating a custom list shell.

Agent Conversation.copy: Delegates message history, reply input, attach action, sending, disabled, offline, error, and handoff behavior through Agent Conversation, Chat Thread, Chat Message, and Chat Composer.

Agent state.copy: Shows assignment, unread count, and recovery posture while preserving selected conversation context.

Handoff recovery.copy: Uses Status Feedback View for handoff, permission, offline, and error recovery instead of custom banners.

Workspace context.copy: Keeps driver, card, station, and case evidence attached to the active conversation.

Agent Workspace.standard: This template is the agent conversational workspace: queue, thread, composer, and evidence context must behave as one product surface.
Agent Workspace.screenSystem: The screen system separates queue, conversation, composer, context, and recovery while keeping selected conversation state shared.
Agent Workspace.informationArchitecture: Navigation follows agent work: pick a conversation, inspect history, reply, attach context, and hand off when needed.
Agent Workspace.primary: Agent resolves a driver support conversation while preserving message history, evidence, and recovery state.
qualityGates: Conversation selection keeps thread, composer, and context panel synchronized.
Composer states are controlled by template state and never bypass Chat Composer behavior.
Handoff, offline, permission, and error states use Status Feedback View instead of custom banners.

patternDetails.Agent Conversation: Owns the governed chat composition boundary so the template does not render local chat bubbles, local composer fields, or custom message state.
patternDetails.Topbar: Provides global search, workspace actions, account affordance, and shell state without redefining input, button, avatar, or notification behavior.
patternDetails.Status Feedback View: Owns handoff, offline, permission, and error feedback so the workspace does not invent local recovery banners.

Case operations.copy: Delegates triage, filters, detail drawer, activity timeline, and feedback to Case Management.

Ticket operations.copy: Delegates ticket queue, alerts, selection, detail drawer, and feedback to Ticket Queue.

Account operations.copy: Delegates dense account records, detail drawer, and audit timeline to Account Operations.

Pricing operations.copy: Delegates pricing rules, approvals, editable table, and permission policy to Pricing Operations.

Backoffice approvals.copy: Delegates document review, approval decisions, detail drawer, and recovery to Backoffice Approval.

Growth operations.copy: Uses Dense Operational List for growth experiments so growth-brutal does not escape Surface or theme contracts.

Internal Operations Console.standard: This template is the governed desktop shell for internal operations; it composes Flow patterns and does not own local tables, drawers, filters, or feedback.
Internal Operations Console.screenSystem: The screen system separates global shell, operations navigation, and operations workspace while preserving selected module state.
Internal Operations Console.informationArchitecture: Navigation follows product operations: triage cases, resolve tickets, review accounts, manage pricing, decide approvals, and monitor growth.
Internal Operations Console.primary: Operator moves between internal operations modules while keeping shell, density, permissions, and recovery behavior consistent.
qualityGates: Module selection keeps topbar, sidebar, and operations workspace synchronized.
Every operational table, filter, drawer, timeline, approval, and feedback behavior is delegated to patterns.
Growth-brutal and pricing surfaces stay within Surface, density, state, and theme contracts.

patternDetails.Topbar: Owns global actions, search entry, workspace state, and account affordances.
patternDetails.Sidebar: Owns desktop navigation, active state, hierarchy, and drawer handoff.
patternDetails.Case Management: Owns case filters, dense list, detail drawer, timeline, and feedback.
patternDetails.Ticket Queue: Owns ticket alerts, dense list, detail drawer, and recovery feedback.
patternDetails.Account Operations: Owns account records, dense list, detail drawer, and audit timeline.
patternDetails.Pricing Operations: Owns pricing rules, editable queue, role policy, and feedback.
patternDetails.Backoffice Approval: Owns approval queue, decision states, detail drawer, and feedback.
patternDetails.Dense Operational List: Owns reusable dense growth operations list without cloning tables.
